tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind cards. Cool light grey in light, near-black slate in dark.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet blocks inside a card: table header row, read-only fields, code of a memo.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, inputs, bottom nav. White in light; one step above the ground in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, modals, bottom sheets. In dark it is lighter than surface, because shadows barely read there.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Toasts and tooltips: the one inverted surface.

tokens.name: fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash on nav items, ghost buttons, list rows.

tokens.name: fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed wash on the same.

tokens.name: fill-hover-raised
tokens.usage: Hover wash inside raised surfaces (menus, popovers, calendar), where dark fill-hover would match surface-raised.

tokens.name: fill-pressed-raised
tokens.usage: Pressed wash inside raised surfaces.

tokens.name: fill-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control fill. Never lower opacity instead.

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Skeleton loader blocks; dark steps two shades above surface so it shows on cards.

tokens.name: segment-track
tokens.usage: The recessed track behind a filter or segmented control in the workbench.

tokens.name: segment-selected
tokens.usage: The raised, selected option inside segment-track. Paired with shadow-xs and a border hairline.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and headings. AAA (≥7:1) on bg, bg-subtle, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Second lines, labels in tables, the address on the title. ≥7:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Timestamps, placeholders, helper text. ≥4.5:1 on bg, bg-subtle and surface. Never on a coloured fill.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (WCAG exempts them); pair with a reason when it matters.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse (toasts, tooltips).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline card borders and dividers. Decorative: nothing relies on it alone.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button outline, segmented control frame, hover border of a selection card.

tokens.name: border-field
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox, radio and switch-track edges. ≥3:1 on bg and surface in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, checked controls, the brand mark. The SAME value in both themes, so the brand never changes colour with the theme. One primary per view.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover. One step darker in both themes; on-accent stays ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an accent fill. ≥4.5:1 on accent, accent-hover and accent-pressed in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, the active nav label and icon, selected sort arrow. ≥4.5:1 on bg, surface and accent-subtle.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Active nav item fill, selected table row, the Trợ lý monogram ground.

tokens.name: accent-subtle-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on an accent-subtle fill.

tokens.name: accent-border
tokens.usage: Border of an accent-subtle block when it sits on surface.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid ring 2px outside the control. ≥3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text-inverse-accent
tokens.usage: An action word on surface-inverse, such as Hoàn tác in a toast.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Paid, saved, complete. Word and icon colour. ≥4.5:1 on success-bg, bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Paid, saved, complete. Badge and banner fill behind success-text.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Paid, saved, complete. Banner border on surface.

tokens.name: success-solid
tokens.usage: Paid, saved, complete. Solid fill (count badge). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on success-solid.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Due soon, needs a look, low-confidence extraction. Word and icon colour. ≥4.5:1 on warning-bg, bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Due soon, needs a look, low-confidence extraction. Badge and banner fill behind warning-text.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Due soon, needs a look, low-confidence extraction. Banner border on surface.

tokens.name: warning-solid
tokens.usage: Due soon, needs a look, low-confidence extraction. Solid fill (count badge). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on warning-solid.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Overdue, failed, destructive. Never the brand. Word and icon colour. ≥4.5:1 on danger-bg, bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Overdue, failed, destructive. Never the brand. Badge and banner fill behind danger-text.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Overdue, failed, destructive. Never the brand. Banner border on surface.

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Overdue, failed, destructive. Never the brand. Solid fill (count badge, destructive button). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger-solid.

tokens.name: info-text

tokens.name: on-info

tokens.name: neutral-text

tokens.name: neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Empty and ended badge fill.

tokens.name: neutral-border
tokens.usage: Neutral banner border.

tokens.name: neutral-solid

tokens.name: on-neutral

tokens.name: qr-ink

families.display: "Inter Display", "Inter", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Once per screen at most: the onboarding hero or a page whose point is one figure. 1.3 leading keeps Ở, Ặ clear of the line above.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Page title on phones; section title on desktop.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card group title, modal and sheet title.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Card title, property name, the first line of a mobile list row.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Phòng 5 đã quá hạn 12 ngày, còn thiếu 3.500.000 ₫.
styles.usage: All running text. 16px at 100% is the floor for anything Mẹ reads to act.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Primary cell of a table row, a person or place name inside text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels, nav items, tabs.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Theo sổ: P. Dĩ An, TP. Dĩ An, Bình Dương
styles.usage: Second lines, helper and error text, table cells in Gọn.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, counts, badge words. Never the only place a fact a person must act on lives.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The one summary figure of a hero card. Always with .es-num (tabular, lining).

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: Stat card value; the amount in the record-payment sheet.

styles.name: figure-md
styles.usage: Secondary stat, property card rent, a total row.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Amounts in tables and lists, right-aligned.

styles.name: brand-hero
styles.usage: Brand layer only: the one headline of a website hero or sign-in page. Inter Display Light; leading 1.2 so stacked marks (Ỗ over ặ) clear. Never inside the app.

styles.name: brand-title
styles.usage: Brand layer only: section headlines on the website, onboarding steps, report covers.

styles.name: brand-figure
styles.usage: Brand layer only: one large figure on a marketing card or report cover, with its unit raised (es-mk-unit). In the app, figures use figure-* in Inter.

styles.name: brand-eyebrow
styles.sample: SỔ CÁI NHÀ ĐẤT CỦA GIA ĐÌNH
styles.usage: Brand layer only: spaced capitals above a headline or a marketing figure. Set uppercase in CSS (es-mk-eyebrow). Never as an app label.

spacing.note: 4px base. Sizes are rem, so the member’s text size (100 / 115 / 130%) grows spacing with type.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: 0px. Collapsed.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: 2px. Icon-to-text nudge, badge inner gap.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 4px. Tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: 6px. Badge icon gap, label-to-hint.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: 8px. Icon-to-label in buttons and nav; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 12px. Input inner padding; gap between related fields in Gọn.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: 16px. Page gutter on phones; card padding in Gọn; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: 20px. Gap between fields in Thoáng.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: 24px. Card padding in Thoáng; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: 32px. Section gap; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: 40px. Gap between page header and content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: 48px. Large section breaks.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: 64px. Empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: 80px. Page top on wide desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox box, focus ring on small marks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tooltips, keyboard keys, citation chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, nav items, icon-only buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, table container, selection cards, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals, property card, the record-payment sheet on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of a mobile bottom sheet.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, avatars, switch, count dots, segmented thumb.

shadow.note: Hairline border first; shadow only adds lift. Cool slate ink in light, plain black in dark where surfaces carry elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Cards at rest, with a border.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Hovered clickable card, bottom nav, sticky table header once scrolled.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the family switcher list, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and bottom sheets, over the scrim.

stroke.note: Border widths and the focus ring geometry.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline

tokens.name: stroke-strong
tokens.usage: Checkbox and radio edges, the completeness ring track.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width (outline, never a border, so nothing shifts).

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its focus ring.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Lucide stroke width at 16–24px. 2 at 14px.

size.note: Fixed sizes. Density changes control and row heights; it never changes these or the type.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Smallest hit area on a touch screen, in both densities.

tokens.name: control-lg

tokens.usage: Inside badges, beside caption.

tokens.name: icon-sm

tokens.name: icon-md

tokens.name: icon-lg

tokens.name: avatar-sm

tokens.name: avatar-lg

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Icon rail between 840px and 1080px.

tokens.name: bottom-nav-height
tokens.usage: Mobile tab bar, before the safe-area inset.

duration.note: Motion confirms; it never decorates. All of it drops to 0 (opacity cross-fades stay at duration-fast) under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, colour and border changes, focus ring.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Switch thumb, checkbox tick, menu open, toast enter.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Modal enter, row insert, accordion.

tokens.name: duration-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet slide-up on phones. Exits run at duration-base.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Anything that changes in place: colour, size, position on screen.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Things arriving: sheet, modal, toast, menu. Fast start, long calm settle; no overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving. Always shorter than the enter.
